name: continuity
description: A live context gauge, session length and prompt-cache countdown above the prompt; past a threshold it writes a handover note, compacts at the end of the turn and continues from the note, and it resumes after a 5-hour limit resets.

threshold.title: Handover at (% of context)
threshold.description: When the context fill reaches this percentage at the end of a turn, write the handover note, compact, and continue

resumeAfterLimit.title: Continue after the 5-hour limit resets
resumeAfterLimit.description: When a turn stops at the 5-hour usage limit, wait for the reset and continue by itself (a countdown shows while blocked)

cacheTtl.title: Cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto follows Claude Code's rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, promptCacheTtl, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 1h on a subscription, 5m otherwise) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

cacheYellowAt.title: Cache timer yellow at (share left)
cacheYellowAt.description: The cache timer turns yellow when this share of the cache lifetime is left (0.25 = 15:00 of a 1h cache)

cacheRedAt.title: Cache timer red at (share left)
cacheRedAt.description: The cache timer turns red, and one toast shows, when this share of the cache lifetime is left (0.1 = 6:00 of a 1h cache)

cacheToast.title: Toast when the cache timer turns red
cacheToast.description: One toast per cache entry when the cache timer turns red
